notes.title: ✨ Kingdom of Velvet Chains — Out Now! ✨
notes.content:
[p]Step into the kingdom of [b]Amarta[/b], torn apart by betrayal, intrigue, and the hunger for power. On the throne sits a young elven queen — and it is you who will decide her fate.[/p][p]💎 Enjoy stunning visuals, a dark and sensual atmosphere, and a story where magic, passion, and choices shape the destiny of the entire realm.[/p][p]👑 Will you stand by the queen to help her hold her throne, or become the reason for her downfall?[/p][p][b]Kingdom of Velvet Chains[/b] awaits you!

notes.title: 🖼️ Our 3D Artist 🖼️
notes.content:
[p]We’re proud to introduce the talented 3D artist behind the stunning visuals of Amarta — Max Smeagol. As the original creator of Amarta story and a seasoned 3D artist with years of experience, Max has crafted countless adult erotic comic series that are as imaginative as they are visually striking.  

His work brings passion, emotion, and intensity to every render — and we’re deeply thankful for his generous contribution to this project.  

If you’d like to explore more of his amazing work and support the artist who helped make Kingdom of Velvet Сhains possible, be sure to check out his pages:
